quests.sentence: Despite having spent twenty years in the city, she had never once visited the famous museum.

quests.sentence: Despite living right next to it, she rarely makes time to visit the local gallery.

quests.sentence: By the time the rescue team finally reached them, the survivors had been waiting for over thirty hours.

quests.sentence: Not until a reader reaches the final chapter does the novel's central theme become entirely clear.

quests.sentence: Not until she has read every word of the book will she fully grasp its lasting significance.
